sentences.zh: Superdog 将挽救他。 帮助！ 她叫。

sentences.en: The man grabbed the rope from Floppy.
sentences.zh: 这男人抓住这绳索从 Floppy。

sentences.en: "You're a real hero." Everyone cheered.
sentences.zh: 你是一个真的英雄。 每个人向。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: It was time for Floppy's adventure to end.
sentences.zh: 它是时间为了 Floppy 冒险到末尾。

sentences.en: "I can't say I'm sorry," thought Floppy.
sentences.zh: 我不能说我是对不起， 想 Floppy。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: 我看见， 他说。

sentences.en: Biff was cross when she found Floppy on her bed.
sentences.zh: Biff 是叉形当……时她找到 Floppy 在……上她床。

sentences.en: "You know you mustn't sleep on the bed," she said.
sentences.zh: 你知道你不可以睡觉在……上这床， 她说。

sentences.en: "What a bad dog you are, Floppy!"
sentences.zh: 什么一个坏的狗你是， Floppy！

sentences.en: Floppy jumped off the bed, and crept downstairs.
sentences.zh: Floppy 跳离开这床， 和 crept 在楼下。

sentences.en: "I don't know," he thought.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 他想。

sentences.en: "I'm a hero one minute, and a bad dog the next." They said.
sentences.zh: 我是一个英雄一分， 和一个坏的狗这下一个。 再见， 他们说。

sentences.en: The children took Floppy outside.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们拿 Floppy 外面。

sentences.en: "It's time to do the Dog of the Year course again," they said.
sentences.zh: 它是时间到做这狗的这年进程再一次， 他们说。

sentences.en: Suddenly Floppy ran off.
sentences.zh: 突然地 Floppy 跑离开。

sentences.en: He jumped over the fence and ran away as fast as he could.
sentences.zh: 他跳在……上方这分册和跑离开像快的像他能。

sentences.en: "Come back, you bad dog," shouted Chip.
sentences.zh: 来回来， 你坏的狗， 喊 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Floppy ran into the park and hid inside a giant pipe.
sentences.zh: Floppy 跑进入这公园和 hid 里面一个巨人管子。

sentences.en: "They won't find me in here," he thought.
sentences.zh: 他们不会找到我在……里这里， 他想。

sentences.en: "I don't want to be the Dog of the Year, and I'm not Superdog.
sentences.zh: 我不想要到是这狗的这年， 和我是不 Superdog。

sentences.en: I'm just me.
sentences.zh: 我是刚刚我。

sentences.en: I'm just a floppy old dog who wants a bit of peace." (upbeat music).
sentences.zh: 我是刚刚一个 Floppy 旧的狗谁想要一个一小块的和平。 你必须是音乐家。
